measurement_rules: Do not use UIAutomator click timestamps as camera pipeline latency.
Do not use am start TotalTime as time-to-first-preview-frame.
Use Camera2/instrumentation events for camera timing.
Use bounded iterations or bounded monotonic-time duration for every workload.
Do not use drop_caches for retail-device performance measurements.
Capture thermal state alongside performance evidence.

assumptions: The named instrumentation harness classes are implemented in com.example.cameratest.
Performance harnesses use a monotonic clock internally and emit single-line JSON.
dumpsys media.camera parsing varies by OEM; CameraCharacteristics queried inside the harness should be preferred when dumpsys is insufficient.
Numeric SLA values are framework defaults/placeholders and should be overridden by product requirements or golden-build baselines when available.
Missing capabilities are classified NOT_APPLICABLE and are never invented.
